newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Futuris says full year on track.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Futuris says full year on track.

text.p: Diversified manufacturer and rural services group Futuris Corp Ltd said on Monday its full year result to June 30, 1997 should be in line with forecasts contained in its takeover documents for pastoral group Elders Australia Ltd.

"The directors note that the result for the half year is in line with forecasts contained in the Part A statement which accompanied the takeover offer for Elders Australia Ltd dated July 31 1996," Futuris said in a commentary accompanying its half year results.
"Subject to the assumptions contained in those forecasts, the board has no reason to believe that the outcome for the year ended June 30 1997 will be materially different than forecast."
Futuris earlier announced a fall in net profit to A$22.04 million for the half year from A$32.50 million previously.
The previous six month period included an abnormal gain of A$12.0 million.
Futuris announced last month it intended to compulsorily acquire the remaining shares in Elders after acquiring 95.2 percent of its shares.
